contentList.content: Vludber is a true expert in the chaos of the moment, and he brings real turmoil to the battlefield. Nobody knows how he came into this world, but they say this eccentric halfling is a cunning interplanar creature that takes the shape fitting the current Plane. Beware his random effects, do not let him speak his strangest spells, and never run away!
At the start of his turn, Vludber triggers a random <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_VLUDBER_CHAOTIZATION">Chaotisation</LSTag>, greatly changing the balance of the battlefield.
Chaotisation is a set of special random effects, many of which definitely cannot be called useful. The good news is that Chaos makes no difference between friend and foe.
Vludber can curse a target, making it trigger a random <LSTag Tooltip="WildMagic">Wild Magic</LSTag> effect after every <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> and every spell it casts.
After every <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> and every spell you cast, you trigger a random <LSTag Tooltip="WildMagic">Wild Magic</LSTag> effect.

Vludber knows how the matter of the Plane can be changed, and he weaves the fabric of the battlefield as he pleases. A creature that makes an Attack Roll against him must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw ([3]) or become Mad for [1] turn. After that, it cannot be driven Mad this way for another [4] turns. When he deals damage, Vludber Dominates the creature for [2] turns, unless it is a player.

Every time someone in combat receives a Battle Affliction, all creatures must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw([1]) or fall into uncontrollable laughter for [2] turns. A creature can set this off only once per turn.
Every creature can cast Chain Lightning once per turn at no cost and is Resistant to[1].
A creature that misses with an attack floods the ground within [1] around itself with lava.
At the start of its turn, every creature is granted a guaranteed <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.
Every creature is <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to all damage except physical.
All physical damage returns to its source.
Every creature is <LSTag Tooltip="Vulnerable">Vulnerable</LSTag> to physical damage.
Every creature gains an additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.
Every creature can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Shield_Wizard">Shield</LSTag> once per turn without spending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
Every damage die rolls its maximum.
Every creature is <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to physical damage.
Every creature turns undead: Immune to[1], Resistant to[2], but ordinary healing no longer works on it.
Strength, Dexterity and Constitution of every creature become [1]; Intelligence and Wisdom drop to [2].
Every creature can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Counterspell">Counterspell</LSTag> without limit.
A cloud of spores covers everyone: creatures laugh and stagger at random for [1] turns.
Every creature is Surprised for [1] turns.
Every creature is struck mute and cannot cast spells with a verbal component.
At the end of its turn, every creature grows a meadow of flowers within [1] of itself.
Every creature gains the ability to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FLY">fly</LSTag>.
A creature below [1]% health lands only Critical Hits. Such a Critical Hit ignores every immunity.
Every hit taken permanently lowers the creature's Armour Class by [1].
A creature's critical miss kills its target outright, and its own <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> kills the creature itself.
On a miss, the creature turns and runs until it succeeds on a Wisdom Saving Throw ([1]).
Every condition is stripped from every creature at once — the running Chaotisations included.
Every creature is <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HASTE">Hastened</LSTag>, and the lethargy that normally follows never comes.
Within [1] turns the creature must land a Critical Hit. If it fails, it loses [2]% of its maximum health.
Every Critical Hit rolls [1] extra damage dice.
Every hit taken restores [1]% of the creature's maximum health.
The first time the creature drops below [1]% health, it restores [2]% of its maximum health and all of its spell slots.
Whenever a creature deals damage, it gathers <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_CHARGED_LIGHTNING">Lightning Charges</LSTag> on itself.
Any miss in the fight coats every creature in Frost for [1] turns.
Every creature gains a free Fire Bolt that turns into a Fireball [1]% of the time.
Every hit taken releases a cloud of stinking gas within [1] of the creature.
[1] winged strangers step onto the field, hostile to absolutely everyone.
Destroying an object leaves the creature <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stunned</LSTag> until the end of its turn.
Every creature drops its weapons and cannot keep hold of them.
At the start of its turn, every creature is drawn a new size — from tiny to huge, weight and carrying capacity along with it.
The creature has shrunk to the smallest size. Its weight and carrying capacity have dropped with it.
The creature has shrunk. Its weight and carrying capacity have dropped with it.
The creature has grown. Its weight and carrying capacity have risen with it.
The creature has grown to the largest size. Its weight and carrying capacity have risen with it.
Within [1] turns the creature must roll a critical miss. If it fails, it spends a turn with no Action.
Every damage die rolls its minimum.
Every creature can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MistyStep">teleport a short distance</LSTag> once per turn without spending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.
Every creature gains an additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action</LSTag>.
While moving, a creature has a [1]% chance to slip and fall.
The creature is flat on the ground. Standing up costs half its <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag>.
At the end of its turn, every creature releases a cloud of poisonous fumes within [1] of itself.
When a creature attacks or casts a spell, it swaps places with its target.
Every creature turns Invisible for [1] turns.
At the start of its turn, a creature must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw ([1]) or fall into Madness for [2] turns. A creature holding Concentration is spared.
Every creature drops its worn gear to the ground. Legendary artefacts stay where they are.
